channel.title: Convergence Daily
channel.description: Real Convergence Daily episodes published through the dual-native engine.

item.title: The Factory Floor Got There Before the Ticker
item.description: Humanoid robotics' visible narrative this cycle is unveilings and IPO pricing out of China, but the harder evidence of the sector moving from demo to production is sitting one layer down, in lidar shipment volumes, connector and embedded-silicon production ramps, and new factory openings, none of which the current options coverage or the book's existing TSLA exposure has caught up to yet.

item.title: The AI Factory Trade Has Moved Down the Rack
item.description: The AI Factory Trade Has Moved Down the Rack Thesis AI infrastructure remains a valid bottleneck-stack watchlist, but the clean trade has shifted away from the obvious accelerator narrative toward second-order constraints in custom silicon, packaging, memory, networking, cooling, and power reliability.
